criteria.sourceText: Applications for SPDC scholarship can only be submitted by students of the first year of the Undergraduate courses
The applicant must have secured a minimum of 60% aggregate marks or equivalent grades in aggregate of all the subjects in the Senior Secondary (10+2) or equivalent examination.
The total household monthly income of the parent(s) of the applicant should NOT exceed an amount equivalent to US Dollar Five Thousand (US$ 5000).
Applicants from all the categories must have passed grade 11th and 12th from abroad.

note: Rules misread the 2025-26 guidelines (Class 11, Nepal residence, Pakistan/Bangladesh citizenship, medicine only, the ECR US$ 3000 limit). Replaced with the scheme's own conditions for NRI/PIO/OCI children; age 17-21 has no Profile field. The ECR studied-in-India category (17 places) is not covered by destinationIsResidence no.
